grammatica.evidence: Flag rows use stock CLI-doc templates: `--flag` | type | `default` | short meaning; bash fences; brief declaratives for exits.

dialectica.evidence: Lead 'Values shown are the defaults' plus dry-run comment on bare `rotate`; little inference needed for flag/default lookup itself.

rhetorica.evidence: Chose 4-col Flag/Type/Default/Meaning tables per verb; plan's six flags then rotate's three; examples/exit/EARLY demoted after tables.

arithmetica.evidence: Nine flag triples not public: e.g. `--days`/`14`, `--rack-rows`/`6`, `--format`/`table`, `--state`/`rack.json`, `--apply`/`false`.

geometria.evidence: YAML frontmatter; H1; lead; ## plan + table + example + exits; ## rotate + snippet + table + EARLY note — scan-first layout.

musica.evidence: Parallel table-row staccato (one flag per line); short meaning phrases; denser only in exit-code and EARLY sentences.

astronomia.evidence: Arc: purpose lead → plan flags (lookup core) → plan extras → rotate flags → rotate extras; density peaks at tables mid-section.

notes: Fictional CLI vs public substrate: flag defaults are Original; table form/register is Stock/Selected for a flag-lookup telos.
